title: Desk pen holder
prompt: Desk pen holder: an 80 x 40 x 3 mm base plate with two round cups standing on it. Each cup is 30 mm outside diameter with a 2 mm wall and 60 mm tall (measured from the top of the base), centred on the base's long centreline 20 mm from each end. The cups are open tubes; the base plate is their bottom. Base corner at the origin, Z up.

Two 30 x 60 mm tubes (inner and outer wall) standing on top of the base (from Z = 3)
Cup bores (26 mm) centred at X = 20 and X = 60 on the Y = 20 centreline
Total volume ≈ 30712 mm³ ±1% (checks the 2 mm walls)
